summary: This Form 8-K filed by Brand Engagement Network Inc. reports entry into a definitive Reseller Agreement with Accelevate Solutions, granting exclusive rights for the African continent for five years with annual renewal subject to revenue thresholds. The licensor receives 35% of gross revenue (excl. hardware). This is a commercial distribution agreement, not a special situation like an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. There are no deal terms typical of M&A transactions. The filing is a routine current report on a material definitive agreement, thus categorized as None.
